sources.title: Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 model card
sources.evidence: Exact Instruct checkpoint, published by mistralai with Apache-2.0 metadata. Describes an update to Small 3.1 with improved instruction following, fewer repetitive generations, and a more robust function-calling template; supplies image-input/text-output and tool-calling examples. Its Key Features explicitly inherit the Small 3.1 Instruct card.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration combines a 40-layer Mistral text model with a 24-layer Pixtral vision encoder. Text max_position_embeddings is 131072; configuration declares attention and feed-forward dimensions and BF16 weights.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint native Mistral parameters configuration
sources.evidence: Native configuration independently sets max_position_embeddings to 131072, with 40 text layers, grouped-query attention, dense feed-forward dimensions, and a 24-layer image encoder plus patch-merge projector.

sources.title: Mistral Small 3.2 official model specification
sources.evidence: The weights row explicitly links Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, separately sets parameters='24' and active='24', names Apache 2.0, and advertises 128k context. Model releaseDate is 2025-06-20; native modalities are text/image input and text output.

sources.title: Official weights-table units renderer
sources.evidence: Renders parameters under Parameters (B) unless explicitly marked T, and active under Active (B). This model's separate values of 24 therefore both use billions.

sources.title: Mistral Small family model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Groups Small 3.0, 3.1, and 3.2 in the same model family and explicitly dates the Mistral Small 3.2 update to June 20, 2025.

sources.title: Mistral release changelog
sources.evidence: The 2025 entries distinguish the June 20 Mistral Small 3.2 model release from June 23 availability of the mistral-small-2506 API.

sources.title: Official chat-template reasoning classification
sources.evidence: The convert_tokenizer_to_chat_template docstring explicitly calls mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 non-reasoning while contrasting it with Magistral-Small-2506. It warns that identical tokenizer metadata cannot establish reasoning capability.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint published tensor index
sources.evidence: Public index maps 585 weight tensors across ten shards: attention and ordinary MLP projections for all 40 text layers, 24 vision layers, embeddings, output head and multimodal projector. No expert/router tensors are present. Used to corroborate architecture and weight availability, not to turn storage metadata into a parameter count.

name.note: Readable exact-variant name from Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506; adding Instruct makes this checkpoint distinct from a generic API label.

developer.note: Published in Mistral AI's official organization and linked directly from its own model specification; retain the catalog's normalized developer label.

family.note: Normalized family key for the Mistral Small lineage; the card identifies Small 3.1 as its predecessor and the legal family page includes 3.2.

release_date.note: Keep the explicit public model release date. June 23 refers to later API availability, not this weights release. Repository creation is also not treated as public release.

open_weights.note: Official specification links downloadable exact-checkpoint weights, and the public repository contains a complete sharded weight index.

license.note: Exact checkpoint model-card metadata and linked official weights row both identify Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total of 24 billion for the exact Instruct weights row, with billion units verified in its renderer. This is not a claim of exactly 24,000,000,000 learned parameters or a storage-element recount.

active_parameters_b.note: The same exact-checkpoint row separately reports Active (B)=24. Preserve this nominal first-party value; it is not inferred by equating a dense model's active and total parameters and does not specify a modality-dependent phase count.

architecture.note: Dense multimodal Transformer: native and Transformers configurations identify the Mistral text decoder plus Pixtral vision encoder/projector; the complete tensor index corroborates attention and single dense MLP projections per layer with no routed expert tensors.

context_window.note: Both exact-checkpoint configuration formats set 131072 positions, resolving the advertised 128k context for these weights. The baseline 256000 is unsupported. This does not assert an API provider's independent serving limit.

modalities.note: Exact card examples and native configuration support images and text as input with text generation. Document-QnA service features do not establish an additional native PDF modality.

reasoning.note: Mistral's implementation documentation explicitly classifies this exact checkpoint as non-reasoning. General problem-solving or vision-reasoning examples are not a dedicated thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Exact model card demonstrates structured tool calls and describes the improved function-calling template; official capabilities also list function calling.

description.value: Instruction-tuned multimodal Mistral Small model with improved instruction following, fewer repetition errors, and a more robust function-calling template than Small 3.1.
description.note: Replace generic efficiency, extraction and production positioning with the exact update's documented changes and modalities.

patch.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct
patch.description: Instruction-tuned multimodal Mistral Small model with improved instruction following, fewer repetition errors, and a more robust function-calling template than Small 3.1.

sources.label: Official total and active parameter specification
Official model lifecycle and release date
Official model and API release changelog

patch.notes: Total 24B and active 24B are nominal values separately published by Mistral for Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, not tensor-exact or phase-specific counts. Native context is 131072 tokens (advertised as 128k). Model release was June 20, 2025; June 23 was later API availability.

summary: Independently audited the exact Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct checkpoint across all 14 fields. Correct context from 256000 to 131072; add Apache-2.0, dense architecture, explicitly reported nominal active 24B, and primary parameter provenance. Clarify the Instruct name and replace the generic description. Confirm June 20 release, open weights, native text/image-to-text modalities, non-reasoning classification and tool calling. No fields remain unverified.
